Game Overview

In Gone Batty, the core idea is straightforward: help Batty the bat soar to the skies in this thrilling arcade adventure. Dodge perilous obstacles, outmaneuver foes, and collect glimmering coins to boost your score. With easy controls but challenging gameplay, Gone Batty demands sharp reflexes and strategic thinking to conquer its spooky challenges. Can you reach new heights?
